title: Making plans
description: Talk about future arrangements using will and going to.

introduction.headline: Plan the near future
introduction.body: Learn when to use will for decisions and offers, and going to for intentions.
introduction.bodyIt: Impara quando usare will per decisioni e offerte, e going to per intenzioni.
objectives: Use going to for plans and intentions
Use will for offers and decisions
Arrange a meeting or trip in English

vocabulary.example: Shall we arrange a call for Monday?
My intention is to leave early.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: La mia intenzione è partire presto.

vocabulary.example: Looking at my schedule, Friday works.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Guardando il mio calendario, venerdì va bene.

exercises.prompt: Choose the best sentence for a planned intention.
exercises.promptIt: Scegli la frase migliore per un'intenzione pianificata.
options: I am going to book the tickets tonight.
I will going to book the tickets tonight.
I going book the tickets tonight.
I am will book the tickets tonight.
exercises.answer: I am going to book the tickets tonight.
exercises.explanation: Use going to for intentions you have already decided.

exercises.prompt: Don't worry — I ____ help you with the booking.
exercises.promptIt: Completa: Don't worry — I ____ help you with the booking.
exercises.explanation: Use will for offers and spontaneous decisions.
Available means free and able to meet or do something.

review.tip: Plan a weekend with a friend using going to and one will offer.
